fullPassage: One day, my father took me and my brother on a camping trip. While driving to a nearby forest, he explained how to set up the tent. Almost immediately after we arrived, however, my brother was stung by a wasp, which caused his forehead to swell. We tried to catch our dinner by fishing in a nearby lake, but we failed miserably, returning with nothing but dozens of mosquito bites. Without any fish, we cooked a can of beans over a campfire, which was an unwise endeavor that burned the bottom layer of beans while leaving those on top cold. When bedtime came, we unrolled my father's old sleeping bags to find them stinking of damp mold. The odor was so overpowering that even my father gave up. We packed the tent, got in the car, and drove home.

questions.passage: One day, my father took me and my brother on a camping trip. While driving to a nearby forest, he explained how to set up the tent. Almost immediately after we arrived, however, my brother was stung by a wasp, which caused his forehead to (A)[shrink / swell]. We tried to catch our dinner by fishing in a nearby lake, but we (B)[failed / succeeded] miserably, returning with nothing but dozens of mosquito bites. Without any fish, we cooked a can of beans over a campfire, which was an (C)[unwise / wise] endeavor that burned the bottom layer of beans while leaving those on top cold. When bedtime came, we unrolled my father's old sleeping bags to find them stinking of damp mold. The odor was so overpowering that even my father gave up. We packed the tent, got in the car, and drove home.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) swell=붓다 / shrink=줄어들다 (B) failed=실패했다 / succeeded=성공했다 (C) unwise=어리석은 / wise=현명한
det.analysis:
(A) 벌에 쏘여 이마가 '부어오르다' → swell(shrink=줄어들다는 반대)
(B) 낚시에 '실패했다' → failed(succeeded=성공했다는 반대)
(C) 통조림 콩을 태운 '어리석은' 시도 → unwise(wise=현명한은 반대)
세 자리 모두 원문 단어 조합인 ①이 정답 ←정답
det.tip: 안 좋은 캠핑 이야기 흐름 → 부정적 단어(swell/failed/unwise)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) immediately=즉시 / eventually=결국 (B) burned=태웠다 / froze=얼렸다 (C) overpowering=압도적인 / faint=희미한
det.analysis:
(A) 도착하자마자 '즉시' 벌에 쏘였다 → immediately(eventually=결국은 문맥에 안 맞음)
(B) 불에 콩 바닥을 '태웠다' → burned(froze=얼렸다는 반대)

원문 조합인 ②가 정답 ←정답
det.tip: so ___ that even my father gave up → 아주 강한(overpowering) 냄새

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) driving=운전하며 / walking=걸으며 (B) cooked=요리했다 / ate=먹었다 (C) packed=(짐을) 쌌다 / unpacked=(짐을) 풀었다
det.analysis:
(A) 숲으로 '운전하며' 텐트 치는 법을 설명 → driving(차로 이동 중이므로 walking=걸으며는 부적절)
(B) 콩 통조림을 불에 '요리했다' → cooked(ate=먹었다는 앞뒤 안 맞음)
(C) 집에 가려고 텐트를 '쌌다' → packed(unpacked=풀었다는 반대, 집에 가는 상황)

det.tip: 마지막에 집으로 돌아가려면 텐트를 packed(쌌다)

③ odor: 냄새, 특히 불쾌한 냄새 — 정의와 정확히 일치 ←정답
④ echo: 메아리 — 청각
det.tip: smell(냄새) + unpleasant(불쾌한) → odor(악취)

questions.passage: When bedtime came, we unrolled my father's old sleeping bags to find them __________ (stink) of damp mold. The odor was so overpowering that even my father gave up.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: stink(동사: 악취가 나다) → stinking(현재분사). find + 목적어 + -ing 구문
det.analysis: 'find them __________ of damp mold'에서 목적어(them) 뒤에 목적격보어로 현재분사가 필요해요. 'find + 목적어 + V-ing'는 '~가 …하고 있는 것을 발견하다'라는 뜻이라, stink를 stinking(악취를 풍기는)으로 바꿔 써요.
det.tip: find + 목적어 + V-ing = ~가 …하고 있는 것을 알게 되다 → stinking

questions.passage: We tried to catch our dinner by fishing in a nearby lake, but we failed miserably, __________ (return) with nothing but dozens of mosquito bites. Without any fish, we cooked a can of beans over a campfire.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: return(동사: 돌아오다) → returning(분사구문). 앞 문장과 이어지는 '~하면서'의 분사구문
det.analysis: 콤마 뒤에서 '(그 결과) ~하면서'로 이어지는 분사구문 자리예요. 주어(we)가 스스로 돌아온 능동이므로 현재분사 returning으로 써요. '실패했고, 그래서 모기 물린 자국만 잔뜩 안고 돌아오면서'라는 의미가 됩니다.
det.tip: 콤마 뒤 '~하면서(능동)' → 현재분사(-ing) → returning

questions.passage: One day, my father took me and my brother on a camping trip. While driving to a nearby forest, he explained how to set up the tent. Almost immediately after we arrived, however, my brother was stung by a wasp, which caused his forehead to swell. We tried to catch our dinner by fishing in a nearby lake, but we failed miserably, returning with nothing but dozens of mosquito bites. Without any fish, we cooked a can of beans over a campfire, which was an unwise endeavor that burned the bottom layer of beans while leaving those on top cold. When bedtime came, we unrolled my father's old sleeping bags to find them __________. The odor was so overpowering that even my father gave up. We packed the tent, got in the car, and drove home.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: packed with warm blankets=따뜻한 담요로 채워진 / filled with fresh air=신선한 공기로 가득 찬 / covered in bright colors=밝은 색으로 뒤덮인 / stinking of damp mold=축축한 곰팡이 악취가 나는
det.analysis:
① packed with warm blankets: 뒤 문장에서 냄새가 압도적이라 했으니 '따뜻한 담요'는 흐름과 반대
② filled with fresh air: '신선한 공기'는 악취 문맥과 정반대
③ covered in bright colors: '밝은 색'은 냄새와 무관
④ stinking of damp mold: 낡은(old) 침낭에서 축축한 곰팡이 악취 → 다음 문장 overpowering odor와 연결 ←정답
det.tip: old sleeping bags + 다음 문장 The odor(냄새) → 곰팡이 악취(stinking of damp mold)

② a safe choice: 결과가 엉망이라 '안전한 선택'도 안 맞음
③ a great success: 요리가 실패했으므로 '대성공'은 정반대
④ an unwise endeavor: 바닥은 태우고 위는 차게 만든 → '어리석은 시도' ←정답
det.tip: burned the bottom while leaving the top cold(엉망 결과) → unwise endeavor(어리석은 시도)
